players.bio: Božo Mikulić born 29 January 1997) is a Croatian footballer who plays for Scottish Premiership side St Johnstone. Apart from his initial two years at NK Omladinac Vranjic, Mikulić spent his entire youth career in RNK Split, becoming a youth international in 2014.
Cheick Tiemoko Diabate (born 21 January 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Championship club St Johnstone.
Craig Hepburn is a 21-year-old professional football goalkeeper from Scotland who plays for the Scottish Premiership club St. Johnstone F.C..
Daniel Finlayson is a professional footballer who last played for Scottish Premiership side St Johnstone.

Enes Alić is a 26-year-old Bosnian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for the Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone F.C.. Born on 3 September 1999 in Sarajevo, he recently made headlines with his summer 2026 move to Scotland.

Jack Baird is a 30-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as a powerful centre-back defender for Raith Rovers. He completed a permanent transfer to the Scottish Championship club on 28 August 2026, signing a two-year contract after moving from St Johnstone for an undisclosed fee.

Jamie Gullan is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone. Gullan has previously played for Hibernian, where he spent loan spells with Gala Fairydean Rovers, Queen's Park and Raith Rovers, before joining Raith permanently in 2022.

Jason Derek Holt (born 19 February 1993) is a Scottish professional footballer, who plays as a midfielder for St Johnstone. Holt has also previously played for Heart of Midlothian, Raith Rovers, Sheffield United and Fleetwood Town. He represented Scotland at under-19, under-20 and under-21 level.
Joel Leigh Cotterill (born 10 October 2004) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone.

Josh Campbell (born 6 May 2000) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Hibernian. Campbell has previously played for Airdrieonians, Arbroath and Edinburgh City, and represented Scotland once at under-21 level.
Josh Fowler (born 14 November 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a striker Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone.

Kai Colin Fotheringham (born 18 April 2003) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for St Johnstone. He made his senior debut for Dundee United in 2020 and has also spent time on loan with Falkirk, Raith Rovers, Cove Rangers and Stirling Albion.

Liam Smith is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone. . He has previously played for Heart of Midlothian, East Fife, Raith Rovers, St Mirren, Ayr United and Dundee United.

Logan Chalmers is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership side St. Johnstone. He has also previously played for Dundee United and has loan spells at Arbroath, Inverness Caledonian Thistle, twice with Ayr United and Tranmere Rovers.
Louis Lloyd (born 15 October 2003) is a Welsh footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish club St Johnstone.

Macaulay Tait (born 27 August 2005) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Livingston on loan from Scottish Premiership club Heart of Midlothian.
Matthew Colin Foulds is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone.
Matthew Todd (born 14 June 2001), commonly known as Matty Todd, is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a Midfielder for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone.

Morgan Boyes is a 25-year-old Welsh professional footballer who plays as a defender for the Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone F.C.. Known primarily as a left-footed centre-back, he is also highly comfortable filling in at left-back.

Reece McAlear (born 12 February 2002) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for St Johnstone. Career He joined Norwich City from Motherwell for an undisclosed fee in summer 2019. He made his debut on 28 November 2020 as a substitute in a league match against Coventry City.
Ross Sinclair (born 7 May 2001) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone.

Ruari Michael Paton (born 9 August 2000) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone. He has represented the Republic of Ireland at under-16 level. Paton, a talented dancer, spent his youth with Shelbourne, St Kevin's Boys and Belvedere, before he left Ireland to join the development squad at Scottish club Hibernian.

Samuel Stanton is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone. He has also previously played for Hibernian, with loan spells at each of Cowdenbeath, Livingston & Dumbarton, before moving to Dundee United, Phoenix Rising and Dundalk as well as representing Scotland at youth international level.
Simo Johannes Valakari (born 28 April 1973) is a Finnish football manager and a former international football player. He is currently the manager of Scottish Premiership side St Johnstone.
Taylor Steven is a 21-year-old Scottish professional footballer who plays as a right winger or forward for St Johnstone F.C..
Toby Peter Gary Steward is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership side St Johnstone, on loan from EFL Championship club Portsmouth.

Zach Joseph Mitchell (born 9 January 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Scottish Premiership club St Johnstone on loan from EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic.
